text:
nico_sales: Heads-up: Heliant POC blocked. DocuSign rejects second signer (role mismatch). They want Net45 and EU HSM addendum. Need quick path to start infra this week.

ds-bot: system: envelope validation error. code=ROLE_MISMATCH
````
recipient mismatch: expected role 'EntB' email 'pm@heliant.eu' got 'pm+test@heliant.eu'
POST /v2/envelopes/validate
````
nico_sales: @raj_procure @irma_legal any fast workaround?

raj_procure: PO is acceptable for provisioning. Finance requires PO#, billing contact, and orderform reference. We can start provisioning on PO under Net45 if we have envelope ID or MSA ref for records.

irma_legal: For a short-term POC we can accept: primary entity MSA signed + secondary entity consent email referencing the OrderForm. I'll draft a two-paragraph consent and HSM addendum (jurisdiction EU, customer-managed keys). ETA 6-8h.

andy_eng: Tech can create temporary scoped API keys and a subaccount so they can run the POC before final countersign. We'll need an email ack and PO#. If DocuSign is flaky, option is two envelopes (one per entity) and cross-reference both in the orderform.

zoe_finance: HSM surcharge = +15% on the dedicated key line. Invoice must show a separate line: 'EU HSM (monthly)'. We can combine into one invoice referencing both envelope IDs or both POs.

nico_sales: Plan: 1) ask customer for PO and exact signer emails, 2) Irma sends consent + HSM draft, 3) Andy stands by to reprovision subaccount and resend envelope. Target: POC running by EOW.

raj_procure: If PO not received in 48h escalate to AE. I'll monitor.

irma_legal: Sending drafts now to procurement@heliant.com, cc billing@redwood.com.

andy_eng: CLI fix if needed:
````
docusign-cli envelopes resend --template tpl_heliant_v1 --roles '[{"roleName":"EntA","email":"ceo@heliant.com"},{"roleName":"EntB","email":"pm@heliant.eu"}]' --force-validate
````

nico_sales: Thanks team, updating customer now.
